title: What if every internet connection stopped for 24 hours?

lines.text: What would happen to modern civilization if every internet connection died for twenty-four hours?
lines.caps: What if the *internet | vanished for | *24 hours?

lines.text: Immediately, five billion smartphone users would tap their screens in bewildered frustration.
Financial transactions would freeze, rendering credit cards, ATMs, and stock exchanges useless.
Air traffic control systems would revert to manual backup procedures, causing colossal flight groundings.
Hospitals and emergency responders would scramble as cloud-hosted patient databases disconnect.
Yet communities would suddenly step outside, talking face-to-face and noticing the blue sky again.
lines.caps: People step *outside | and talk to neighbors | *again!

lines.text: The global economy would lose over fifty billion dollars, reminding us how fragile our digital world really is.
lines.caps: Proving how *fragile | our connected world | really *is!
